name: Finance Startup Statements
tagline: Startup finance pitch deck with light blue pages, heavy black sans titles, hand-drawn statement sheets, coin ornaments, tables, runway, and use-of-funds layouts.

palette.description: Light blue financial deck surface with black line art, darker blue accents, pale table panels, white highlights, and gray grid marks.

typography.style: Heavy modern sans headings and readable financial table text.

best_for: Fundraising decks, CFO reviews, financial statement walkthroughs, startup board packets, runway analysis, and use-of-funds narratives.
avoid_for: Luxury launches, expressive creative portfolios, or consumer brand stories where finance-table density would feel too operational.

source_inspiration.name: Slidesgo Financial Statements for Startups Pitch Deck
source_inspiration.notes: Independent high-fidelity HTML/CSS reconstruction based on public preview thumbnails: light blue background, heavy black title type, hand-drawn financial sheets, coin ornaments, and black-line tables. No source assets are embedded.
